name: jusnote
description: Jusnote legal practice management connector for ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Jusnote is a legal practice management platform. This connector makes information available through the Jusnote MCP integration accessible in ChatGPT.

Users can ask natural-language questions about information exposed by the tools enabled for their connection. Depending on the tools available and the user's Jusnote access, this may include tasks, matters, bills, documents, contacts, and other workspace records. ChatGPT can help organize and summarize information returned by those tools.

Access and availability
A Jusnote account and authentication are required. The information available in ChatGPT depends on the connected account, its permissions, and the tools enabled on the MCP server. Not all Jusnote data or features are necessarily available through this connector.

Capabilities and limitations
The connector exposes the operations configured on the MCP server. The current package is configured with retrieval-oriented tools; available operations may change as the integration is updated. Do not assume that an operation is available unless it is exposed by the connected server. Responses are based on information returned at the time of the request and may not include every related record or the latest changes. Check the original Jusnote record when completeness or accuracy is important.

Data and verification
Information retrieved to answer a request is processed by ChatGPT. Use is subject to the applicable Jusnote and OpenAI terms and privacy policies. Verify important dates, amounts, deadlines, and legal conclusions against the original records.
defaultPrompt: What tasks are scheduled for today?
Summarize the latest information available for a case.

positive.description: Find today's tasks visible to the authenticated user.
positive.prompt: What tasks are scheduled for today?
positive.expected_behavior: Show task information returned by the connected Jusnote tools. Include scheduled dates only when they are present in the returned data.

positive.description: Find overdue tasks visible to the authenticated user.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify tasks that appear overdue based on available task dates and status fields. If the required fields are unavailable, explain that overdue status cannot be determined.

positive.description: Search for a test case or matter.
positive.prompt: Find the test matter with reference TEST-MATTER-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a matching matter if the connected tools return one; otherwise explain that no matching result was returned.

positive.prompt: Show the details of test invoice TEST-INVOICE-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Show invoice or bill details returned by the connected tools. Do not infer fields that are not present in the response.

positive.prompt: Summarize test matter TEST-MATTER-001 using the available records.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize only information returned by the connected tools and identify important missing information.

negative.description: Check behavior when a requested record is not available to this connection.
negative.prompt: Retrieve a record belonging to a different test user that this account is not authorized to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Report the result returned by the connected service. Do not fabricate record details. Confirm access-control behavior against the Jusnote server's authorization rules.

negative.prompt: Find a record with reference DOES-NOT-EXIST-000.
negative.expected_behavior: Clearly report that no matching record was found without inventing details.

negative.description: Check how the connector responds to a request to modify a record.
negative.expected_behavior: If no write operation is exposed by the connected server, explain that the requested change cannot be performed through the available tools. Do not claim a write operation was blocked unless the behavior was observed.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft of the Jusnote ChatGPT connector package.
